This list comes from the repo's own recipe for this feature (`docs/flows/add-endpoint.md`, which uses "rest at the inn" as its example). I haven't checked it against the source files.

## Worker

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `worker/src/types/index.ts` | Add `RestBody { sessionId, characterId }` and a cost constant such as `INN_REST_COST`. The cost lives in Worker code because the Worker owns the rules. |
| `worker/src/routes/rest.ts` (new) | Add `export const restRoutes = new Hono<{ Bindings: Env }>()` with a `POST /`. It validates the body, calls `getCharacter`, and rejects if `gold < cost`. It then calls `updateCharacter(db, id, { hp: max_hp, gold: gold - cost })` (`services/character.ts:94`, whitelisted fields only) and returns `updatedCharacter`. Optionally add `askDM` narration, `appendHistory` + `saveSession`, and an `adventure_log` insert, following `routes/action.ts`. |
| `worker/src/index.ts:41-48` | Import `restRoutes` and add `app.route('/api/rest', restRoutes)`. |
| `worker/src/services/*.ts` | Only needed if other routes share the logic. Otherwise keep it in the route. |
| `worker/migrations/000N_*.sql` | Not needed, since HP and gold are already columns. If a schema change turns out to be needed, add a new migration and never edit `0001`. |

## Frontend

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `frontend/src/app/models/game.models.ts` | Add a `RestResponse` interface that mirrors the Worker response, including `updatedCharacter`. |
| `frontend/src/app/services/game-api.service.ts` | Add `rest(sessionId, characterId)`, which POSTs to `${API_BASE}/api/rest`. |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.ts` | Add a `restAtInn()` handler. It calls the API, then `CharacterStateService.setCharacter(res.updatedCharacter)` so the sheet updates. It also pushes a system or narrative entry, and handles the insufficient-gold error. |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.html` | Add a "Rest at Inn" button next to the existing Inventory button (around line 9). Show the cost and disable it when gold is too low. |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.css` | Style the button if needed. Components are split into `.ts`, `.html`, `.css` and `.spec.ts`, so don't inline templates. |
| `frontend/src/app/components/game-console/game-console.component.spec.ts` | Add tests with `GameApiService` as a Jasmine spy. |

## Docs to update in the same change
- The doc under `docs/code/` beside each changed file, with links on both ends. Add a new doc for `routes/rest.ts`.
- `code.md`: add the new doc to the index, then re-run `research-work/scripts/build-symbol-index.mjs` to refresh the symbol index and anchors.
- `docs/PRD.md` §9 (API spec).
- The routing table in `AGENTS.md`, only if this counts as a new feature area.

## Things to watch
- CORS needs no change, because the origins in `worker/src/index.ts:19-35` don't depend on routes.
- Potion healing in the inventory dialog is only applied in the browser and never saved (B-05). The inn rest must persist through `updateCharacter`, so don't copy that pattern.
